issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 01 asks students to output the 'Internetadressen (=url)' of all Zoos, using the German term 'Internetadressen' as the label for the url column (problem-statement.md line 18). The base reference solution aliases this column as 'Internetadresse' to match that label. However, the variant solution (solution/aufgabe01.sql line 1) renames the alias to 'Url' instead: 'SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url as Url, ...'. A student reading the problem statement expects an output column named 'Internetadresse', but the provided solution produces a column named 'Url'. This discrepancy means a student who correctly follows the problem specification will produce output that does not match the reference solution, causing the automatic equality check (test_a01_checkEquality) to fail for a semantically correct query.
issues.suggested_fix: Change 'Zoo.url as Url' back to 'Zoo.url as Internetadresse' in solution/aufgabe01.sql line 1 to match the conceptual label 'Internetadressen' used in the problem statement.
